name: Mometasone
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Asmanex HFA (mometasone furoate), Clinical Pharmacology/Pharmacokinetics — IV terminal t1/2 ≈ 5 h
halfLifeNotes: True elimination half-life after intravenous dosing; the effective half-life after inhalation is ~25 h because slow absorption from the lung rate-limits elimination, and oral bioavailability is negligible (<1%).
